top_signals.title: Aussie Falls to Lowest Since January on RBA Slowdown, AI Fears
top_signals.summary: Australia’s dollar dropped to its lowest level in more than nine months as risk sentiment waned and the interest-rate outlook with the US diverged.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
